none: PAS FindID 897925: Early Medieval Coin: Sceat of class B
contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver coin. Sceat, probably series B issue of 680-710; not individually identified in Abramson 2006 by this reporter. However, Alan Smith kindly comments 'I'm pretty sure this coin is a series F (type 24b) sceatta, Spink no. 781, Abramson F 120'. Obverse description: Diademed head right, hair of numerous pellets and diadem ribbons also pelleted; cross pattee and legend before face, smaller cross…
